one_sentence_summary: Synthetic fixture note: Fixed-threshold benchmark for medical screening discusses medical screening and specificity at fixed recall.
core_claims: medical screening can be evaluated with explicit specificity at fixed recall controls.
main_results: Synthetic result: calibrated screening classifier is evaluated with specificity at fixed recall.
assumptions: synthetic screening cohort reflects enough of the target setting for a first-pass fixture.
stated_limitations: Deployment shift remains unresolved for medical screening.
unstated_limitations: The fixture cannot establish real-world validity for medical screening false positives.
what_it_cannot_answer: Whether real literature already solves medical screening false positives.

quotes_or_evidence_snippets.quote: Evaluation section: calibrated screening classifier is tested on synthetic screening cohort with specificity at fixed recall. The result is used only for offline GapForge evaluation.
